items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I just bought a record last week by a young guitarist, a young Italian guitarist by the name of Pat Martino. And he's just tremendous, tremendous techniques, good ideas.

ctx.x: How about on the guitar, is there a parallel (Inaudible) of innovators?

Yes, yes. Now, you see, guitar, there's a guitar -- it's a fad now, you know. I mean, they just are making guitars and we are getting more young people interested in guitar, and they contribute an awful lot, you see. Any time you get that interest from the youngsters they've got to contribute, and that makes it healthy. And I just -- I love it because I listen. I just bought a record last week by a young guitarist, a young Italian guitarist by the name of Pat Martino. And he's just tremendous, tremendous…

Well, that inspires me, you know, and that actually makes me want to play. I sit and I listen and I listen and I listen, and I analyze what he's doing, and they -- technically he's great, and his ideas are great. And incidently he studied with a very dear friend of mine by the name of Dennis
